content:
Casey (Marketing): Quick sync - product will ship next Tue. Need final public-ready assets by EOD tomorrow so we can: blog, social cadence, webinar invite, and sales routing. Specifically:
- 3–4 changelog one-liners we can paste into the post
- Public doc permalinks + migration anchor IDs
- Benchmarks that are safe to publish + link to notebook
- Exact rollout plan with canary windows (UTC) so we can schedule press embargo and webinar timing
- Sample webhook payload for trial signups so Sales can route leads and tag by model variant
Can we freeze text by EOD tomorrow?

Rohit (Eng): Yes. Changelog one-liners below (please use verbatim):
- Reduced tail latency by optimizing KV eviction heuristics
- Introduced int4 fallback runtime that reduces inference spend on smaller rigs
- Fixed request batching edge-case that affected long-running streams
Commits: d4e5f6..a1b2c3
Rollout plan: Canary start 2027-07-14 01:30 UTC (20m), 10% -> 50% step after 20m, full by 02:30 UTC. No breaking API changes.

Diego (Bench): Publishable summary: p50 256 tokens = 82ms on A100, cost reduction ~36% vs baseline. Public notebook: https://benchmarks.redwood.ai/public/v2-4-lite. Owner: diego@redwood.ai for follow-ups.

Lina (Docs): I'll push docs this afternoon and paste permalinks:
- Release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes#v2-4.2
- Upgrade guide anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/upgrade#kv-eviction
- Migration diff: https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/v2-4-diff
I'll also add a short FAQ for the webinar.

Casey (Marketing): Webhook payload sample for Sales routing? We want trials@ and tags by variant + utm.

Rohit (Eng): Sample POST to /webhooks/signup:
{
  "email":"alice@example.com",
  "org":"BuildCo",
  "plan":"trial-14d",
  "model_variant":"int4-fallback",
  "utm_source":"newsletter",
  "utm_campaign":"v2_4_launch"
}
We will deliver to trials@redwood.com. Add "tags" array if you want explicit routing.

notify-bot: Rollout scheduled by @rohit. Canary window: 2027-07-14T01:30:00Z -> 2027-07-14T02:30:00Z. Steps: 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

Casey (Marketing): Thanks — we'll schedule the blog to publish 5 minutes after full rollout (02:35 UTC) and hold webinar same day at 18:00 UTC. I'll post social templates and UTM guidelines here by tomorrow AM. Please ping if anything changes. :rocket:
